description: A link for someone without an account (usually the brand's owner) to see one post waiting for approval and tap Approve or Ask for changes with a note. Works for 7 days, only for this post, and stops once the post is decided here or there, or when revoked (approval_link_revoke). Send the url to them yourself; it's shown only once. The activity log shows their decision as Approval link (recipient).

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

post_id.description: ID of the post (a UUID): from post_list or post_create

recipient.description: Who it's for: their email, or a note like 'Dana at Acme'. Leave out to use the workspace's client (the report schedule's, else the last link's)

name: approval_link_create
title: Approval link for a client
